Sam — 6/13/2025 10:46 AMFriday, June 13, 2025 10:46 AM
She always had the air of someone who held the world by its axes.
I saw her do it, a few times.
She kissed me at the docks, and she made the sky and the stars dance and twist for me ...

She didn't like to come into the City proper, 
and when she did, it wasn't to see me.
I went to meet her in some strange places. 
Sometimes I'd wait for her Sending, use some sort of powder she gave me, 
one to come, and one to go. 

I knew she was important, and busy, and had her plans, but any time I pried 
... she would just tell me to leave. 
She would tell me how little I was, and that I should know little as a result. 
She would dismiss me, then not speak to me for days.
A reminder that she didn't need me, at all.

So, I didn't ask a lot of questions.
I just wanted her. I had nothing else to hold but her. 
She felt like salvation, and that salvation was supposed to hurt.

I should've known. 
When she handed me the ring, she kissed my hand like a goodbye. 
And I still smiled like a fool.

I hated being in that City ... the Arranger too ... but not as much as I hate this.

You sound angry, for a princess. 
You should hold on to that feeling ... for both of us.
